payload.text: The Brennecke Institute developed a thalliline-doped sodium-flow battery intended to reduce electrolyte crossover and aging. An independent audit established the governing cycle life as 8,400 cycles to the 80% capacity knee. The cell’s gravimetric energy density is 148 Wh/kg, while projected stack-level cost at 500 MWh manufacturing scale is $61/kWh. Its thalliline dopant precipitates below 4 °C, requiring cycling to be suspended.
